  "summary": "S1 — Fact: deliver a small browser Battleship game for one person against the computer; the named browser is the usable target and grants authority to deliver there. Assumptions: local use, automatic fleet placement, a 10×10 board, ships of lengths 5, 4, 3, 3, and 2, alternating shots, random valid computer shots, hit/miss and sunk feedback, victory when all opposing ships sink, and a way to start another game. Invalid or repeated shots consume no turn. The player is the sole human actor; the runtime distinguishes each game using a per-game session, with no accounts or shared state across people, devices, or sessions. State is temporary and isolated; a new game, refresh, or server restart ends it. Unhit computer ship positions remain hidden from the player during play.
